name: Student loan
description: A government-administered lending product available to eligible students to cover compulsory fees, course-related costs, and living costs, governed by the Student Loan Scheme Act and administered in conjunction with Inland Revenue.

attributes.summary: The Student Loan provides financial assistance to eligible students for fees, course-related costs, and living costs, with obligations, repayment requirements, and account management administered under the Student Loan Scheme.
attributes.eligibility: Eligible students meeting residency requirements, full-time study status, and approved programme criteria with EFTS limits of 2 and 7 lifetime
attributes.obligations: Repayment obligations, interest on student loans, loan account management, debt write-off provisions, and transfer of loan balances to Inland Revenue
